literal_meaning: পিত্তের রক্ষা (bile or digestive humor এর সংরক্ষণ)
figurative_meaning_en: Satisfying hunger with very minimal food
similar_in_english: enough to keep body and soul together
a mere morsel to stave off hunger
example_sentences_in_bangla: গরিব লোকটি পিত্তিরক্ষা করেই দিন শেষ করল।
আজকের খাবারে সে শুধু পিত্তিরক্ষা করতে পারল।
example_sentences_in_english: The poor man satisfied his hunger with just a little food to get through the day.
Today's meal was barely enough for him to quench his hunger minimally.
history: Derived from Ayurvedic concepts where 'পিত্ত' refers to the bile humor, implying minimal intake to maintain bodily balance in traditional Bengali rural contexts.
note: The idiom reflects frugal living common in Bengali agrarian society.
